subject: Planning Commission Hearing - Item 2
comment: Hi Aaron, I received the public hearing notice for Item 2 re the General Plan Amendments for Jon Jensen. I'm out of town for work this week and won't be able to attend the meeting, please consider my thoughts here. I live at 1942 N 3100 W, Provo, UT 84601, we've lived there for 4 years. I am the (volunteer)president of the Lakeview Fields HOA, it's a small group of 21 single-family homes directly to the north of the parcel in question. Our homes are located in an interesting location because we are impacted by the development of both Provo and Orem, as we live off 2000S. I can tell you firsthand that Orem does not give any weight to the concerns of Provo residents when they are rezoning and approving development. Orem city council approved a rezoning for a large gas station that is going on the NE corner of Geneva and 2000S, despite their planning commission voting against it. My ask is this: please do NOT reduce the density of 1878 N/1804 parcel. Orem has built and is building a mass amount of high and medium-density housing on the west side of Geneva, and we already have the 3 story apartments along the west property line of our homes. The developer paid an insane amount of money for that land and is now scrambling to justify his investment. This will come at a cost to us, not the developer who will take his money and never concern himself one bit with the impact his decisions have had on those of us who are raising families feet away from his poor decision. We already have problems with sewer capacity and unsafe traffic along geneva and 2000S. The original master plan for that land was covered under our HOA and calls for single-family homes. Please leave the plan as single family. Thank you, Tanner Nordstrom -- Tanner Nordstrom (530) 524-8682
